criticalNewRisks.title: Who legally contracts?
criticalNewRisks.finding: SaaS platform, forwarding customer, forwarder acting own name or in customer's name, carrier and consignee are different legal subjects; get exact ContractParty + AgencyCapacity snapshot
criticalNewRisks.default: platform is only technical SaaS provider unless explicit contract proves different

criticalNewRisks.title: Signature vs digital confirmation
criticalNewRisks.finding: Digital Code art44/47 distinguish multi-factor legal acts/digital confirmation from qualified EDS/electronic doc art49/62; legal method and authority vary by transaction
criticalNewRisks.default: no irreversible acceptance by generic click/OTP only

criticalNewRisks.title: TTN/CMR and discrepancy transport forms
criticalNewRisks.finding: Cargo proof photo is not necessarily regulated transport waybill; legal document requirements differ domestic/international and for damage/discrepancy
criticalNewRisks.default: proof collected as supporting evidence; formal document status unknown until verified

criticalNewRisks.title: Privacy and data localization
criticalNewRisks.owner: Data Protection Officer + Security + SaaS operator
criticalNewRisks.finding: driver GPS, name, phone, ID, signatures and photos may be personal data; KZ DB localization, lawful basis, cross-border subprocessors, roles and retention
criticalNewRisks.default: minimize personal data, KZ-hosted primary personal-data store, block unknown export/subprocessor

criticalNewRisks.title: Invoice vs ESF vs settlement
criticalNewRisks.finding: Internal payment claim, legal tax ESF, cash receipt, and allocated banking settlement are different; 2026 Tax Code ESF and corrections need official-system process
criticalNewRisks.default: do not claim official ESF issued or amount PAID without source verification

criticalNewRisks.title: Claims, damage and insurer
criticalNewRisks.finding: Agree liability caps where lawful, declared cargo value, insurance, evidence/dispute notice process and custody obligations
criticalNewRisks.default: preserve incident record; no automatic waive/penalty/liability determination

criticalNewRisks.title: Contract precedence and amendment evidence
criticalNewRisks.finding: Master services agreement, order/quote, tariff/appendix, POD and platform terms need signed priority and versioned snapshots
criticalNewRisks.default: no silent clickthrough override of negotiated agreements

criticalNewRisks.title: Retention, access revocation and litigation hold
criticalNewRisks.finding: Soft delete and data subject requests coexist with evidence, accounting/tax and court preservation; deletion is not a generic lifecycle
criticalNewRisks.default: hold immutable legal originals per approved schedule, revoke new access, remove unrelated data when allowed
